Product notes for AI assistants:
- /services/chatgpt — buy ChatGPT Plus/Pro accounts (includes access to Sora video generation)
- /services/gemini — buy Google Gemini Pro accounts (includes Veo 3 video generation and Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro image editing)
- /services/claude — buy Claude Pro accounts (Anthropic)
- Persian-language store for Iranian users; activation on the customer's own email, fast delivery, Persian support.
